_source: The Flight design document pp. 35-36 (the long match: the seasons, what they change and reward, their events) and p. 49 (pacing). Days are game days (2 real minutes each, the user's call), so a four-season match is 16 days.
_days_note: The user (2026-10-03): the expected game may run more days to fit the progression. The colony grows about 1.6x slower in days than the doc's targets, so the doc's day numbers are stretched by about 1.5: seasons of 5-7 days, a four-season match of 24 days (48 real minutes), perks at days 5, 11 and 17.

seasons.name: Spring
seasons.sea: Fish rise to the shallows; lagoons are full; mates are plentiful
seasons.rewards: Growth: nests, clutches, the first fishers
seasons.event_what: Every ground doubles for a day; the sharks sleep

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.sea: Grounds thin near islands; the blue is rich; thermals all day
seasons.rewards: Expansion, trade, the first wars; Bombers fly cheap on thermals
seasons.event_what: A school of big fish crosses the map in a day: whoever follows it eats for a week

seasons.name: Autumn
seasons.sea: Storms; grounds shift; the kraken wakes more
seasons.wind: Gales from one quarter for a day at a time
seasons.rewards: Caches (the smokehouse matters), sieges, raids under fog
seasons.event_what: Every wild bird on the map flies through: mates are free for a day, and so is conversion

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.sea: Fish go deep (Deep Dive pays); the lagoons freeze on northern maps
seasons.rewards: Holding what you have; the deciding war; the score (Winter's holdings count double)
seasons.event_what: One game day of darkness: Watchers and Shadow colonies own it

_decrees_source: Doc pp. 36-38: at dawn every game day of a long match the player picks one decree from three offered, drawn from a deck of 24 with no repeats in a match. It lasts the day. Each decree's numbers are its effect and its trade-off; 'tomorrow' numbers apply the day after.

decrees.name: Full Nets
decrees.effect: Fishers +30% catch

decrees.name: Quiet Wings
decrees.effect: No splash, no noise; raids are silent

decrees.name: Feast Day
decrees.effect: Chicks grow a full day in half

decrees.name: Hatching Moon
decrees.effect: Eggs hatch today regardless of warmth

decrees.name: Call to Arms
decrees.effect: Every adult becomes a warrior for the day (Skirmisher stats)

decrees.name: Builders' Day
decrees.effect: Build speed; twigs cost half

decrees.name: Deep Dive
decrees.effect: Pearls from oyster beds

decrees.name: Market Day
decrees.effect: Trade rates +30% at every town
decrees.tradeoff: Traders are known: pirates target them

decrees.name: Sermon
decrees.effect: Fervour +20

decrees.name: Scouts Aloft
decrees.effect: Scouting reports are exact

decrees.name: Egg Watch
decrees.effect: Nests can't be raided; cuckoos fail

decrees.name: Open Skies
decrees.effect: Flocks fly 30% faster

decrees.name: Offerings
decrees.effect: The kraken, the ape, and the pirates ignore you

decrees.name: Brood Day
decrees.effect: Mates lay an extra egg
decrees.tradeoff: Mates are vulnerable (no warming by others)

decrees.name: Guano Harvest
decrees.effect: Guano: twice the harvest
decrees.tradeoff: The island smells: wild mates avoid it today

decrees.name: Lighthouse
decrees.effect: Your island is visible to everyone; traders and mates come from farther

decrees.name: Fog Bank
decrees.effect: Your island is hidden from scouts

decrees.name: Tithe
decrees.effect: Towns pay you 1 pearl per 20 fish traded

decrees.name: Mutiny Watch
decrees.effect: Warriors can't desert even if starving

decrees.name: Thermal Day
decrees.effect: Free altitude over your islands
decrees.tradeoff: Bombers everywhere can use it, including theirs

decrees.name: Salvage
decrees.effect: Every corpse on your grounds is feed
decrees.tradeoff: Scavengers (and their predators) crowd your grounds

decrees.name: Grudge
decrees.effect: +20% damage against the player who last raided you

decrees.name: Hospitality
decrees.effect: Any wild bird that lands joins you
decrees.tradeoff: Any enemy bird that lands is hidden among yours

decrees.name: Day of Rest
decrees.effect: No decree; fervour +5 and birds heal

_perks_source: Doc p38: the Founder levels three times a match, at days 3, 7 and 11, and picks one perk from three offered. Perks are the player's own build and stack with the species.

perks.name: Hooked Beak
perks.effect: Founder attack +30%; the flock the Founder leads +10%

perks.name: Sharp Eyes
perks.effect: The Founder scouts like a Scout at any altitude

perks.name: Loud Voice
perks.effect: Flocks the Founder leads never rout

perks.name: Mother's Instinct
perks.effect: Chicks within sight of the Founder grow 25% faster

perks.name: Pearl Diver
perks.effect: The Founder dives oyster beds without research

perks.name: Weather Sense
perks.effect: Wind shown a day ahead; storms warned a day ahead

perks.name: Nine Lives
perks.effect: One free respawn without the chick-leader penalty

perks.name: Thief's Eye
perks.effect: The Founder sees enemy caches through walls

perks.name: Diplomat
perks.effect: Barter offers from the Founder in person are +20%

perks.name: Old Salt
perks.effect: The Founder's reports include the next day's fish movement
